name: @inid/nextjs
description: Sign-in with InID for Next.js: a proxy that keeps the session fresh, auth() and currentUser() on the server, and the React components of @inid/react.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && ../../node_modules/.bin/esbuild src/index.ts src/server.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --target=es2020 --external:react --external:next --external:@inid/react --external:@inid/server --outdir=dist && ../../node_modules/.bin/tsc src/index.ts src/server.ts --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --skipLibCheck
